marcus_voice_anchor:
Forward Deployed AI Accelerator | Corporate Development | Stockholm

We are embedding AI practitioners within GTM and Operations teams to design
and implement autonomous workflows that transform how Teamtailor operates.

Key responsibilities:
- Embed with GTM and Operations teams to understand workflows deeply
- Identify high-leverage transformation opportunities
- Help evaluate and build new tools, agents, automations and skills
  customized per workflow
- Coach teams through progressive AI adoption stages
- Map processes to identify organizational patterns
- Scale successful solutions across teams

We want deep AI practitioners who build agents, automations and tools
fluently, ship internal tools, run cross-functional projects, recognize
patterns, have a bias toward action over theoretical presentations, and
are comfortable with ambiguity in new operating models.
